section.title: Cool Down (5 minutes)
Student Activity

list.item: Explain why it makes sense to call the expression \(x^2+20x+100\) a perfect square.

section.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.
Answer: It is equivalent to \((x+10)^2\), so it is a factor squared.
section.title: Response to Student Thinking
More Chances
section.para: If students solve the second equation by factoring and using the square root property, state that some equations cannot be easily factored and that Lessons 9.2-9.4 explore equations that cannot always be easily factored but can be solved by completing the square.
